summary: Verified BuildMitra wallet transaction sign fix + final production readiness. Wallet display logic in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx (lines 91-107) correctly renders '+₹X' (green, colors.success) for credits (amt>=0) and '−₹X' (red, colors.error, Unicode minus) for debits using Math.abs(amt).toLocaleString(). Backend regression: 115/116 tests pass (99.1%). Wallet withdraw endpoint confirmed to create transactions with negative amount (verified end-to-end: worker withdraws 1 → txn.amount == -1 → frontend now renders as '−₹1' instead of buggy '+₹-1'). SPA serving verified with new bundle hash entry-bd7258f1b2479c1463b6fc81d9b5ec7f.js (200 OK). All 4 health endpoints (/api/health, /api/healthz, /health, /healthz) return 200. The single failure (test_phase1_audit.py::TestRegression::test_complaints_list) is a pre-existing test bug (calls /api/complaints which returns 404 — correct endpoint is /api/complaints/mine), completely unrelated to the wallet fix.

critical_code_review_comments: wallet.tsx sign fix looks clean: uses Number() coercion with 0 fallback, Math.abs() for magnitude, Unicode minus (−) instead of hyphen-minus for typographic correctness, and colors.success/error are theme-safe.

One micro nit (non-blocking): tx.note falls back to tx.type in the label. If tx.type is a machine-readable slug like 'wallet_withdraw', consider a small type→human-label map for polish; but this predates iter13.

success_rate.backend: 99.1% (115/116 total: 9/9 wallet + 29/30 phase1 [1 pre-existing test bug] + 52/52 phase2 + 25/25 phase3)
success_rate.frontend: visual spot-check verified per review_request; wallet.tsx code review confirms correct sign rendering

Withdraw endpoint creates a wallet_txn with negative amount value (schema returns numeric int). Bundle hash after iter13 rebuild: entry-bd7258f1b2479c1463b6fc81d9b5ec7f.js. Pre-existing failing test (unrelated to any recent change): test_phase1_audit.py::TestRegression::test_complaints_list — endpoint should be /api/complaints/mine.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: wallet.tsx unconditionally prefixed '+' to raw tx.amount, so a withdraw txn (amount=-1) rendered as '+₹-1'. Root cause: the display logic didn't branch on the numeric sign; it assumed all amounts were positive credits. Fix (verified): compute isCredit = Number(tx.amount) >= 0, then render `${isCredit ? '+' : '−'}₹${Math.abs(amt).toLocaleString()}` with matching color (green/red). Data source verified end-to-end: /api/wallet/withdraw does insert a wallet_txns doc with amount = -requested_amount (integer), so the frontend now correctly reads and formats the sign.
